rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: SupraWall provides enterprise-grade security for AI agents by intercepting and evaluating tool calls against configurable policies. It blocks dangerous actions, requires human approval for high-risk operations, and maintains compliance-ready audit trails. The MCP plugin integrates directly into Claude Desktop and other MCP-compatible clients without requiring changes to existing agent logic.
